data.name: Landing.Hero.Concept
data.value: Manage, as a Council, a permanent Guild of explorers in service of a deity. The Guild is the true protagonist. The characters who descend into the Dungeon are valuable — but expendable.

data.name: Landing.Pillars.Lethality.Desc
data.value: Death is permanent and part of the game. Every expedition is a real gamble.

data.name: Landing.Pillars.Persistent.Desc
data.value: Time passes and the world changes even without a session. Inactivity has a cost.

data.name: Landing.Pillars.Guild.Desc
data.value: The organization never fully retreats. The character is replaceable; the Guild is not.

data.name: Landing.Pillars.NoXP.Desc
data.value: All evolution is a direct consequence of the activity practiced.

data.name: Landing.Pillars.Interlude.Desc
data.value: The period between expeditions matters as much as the expedition itself.

data.name: Landing.Pillars.Info.Desc
data.value: Rewarding exploration. Knowing the Dungeon is worth as much as brute strength.

data.name: Landing.Quote
data.value: The Guild is the true protagonist of the campaign, and the characters who descend into the Dungeon are valuable resources — but expendable.
